decks.বাংলিশ ফাঁদ: bn-only deck (profile bn.md §9 trap table and deck-content notes, DECKNAMES row 21; 43 cards), appended last, after the shared alphabet deck. Cards 0–29 give the standard / American form for the 20 trap rows (uncountables information / advice / furniture; more better; I am knowing; lakh / crore; lift / flat / mobile; give an exam; eat medicine; drink a cigarette; today morning / yesterday night; cousin brother; good name; hotel = restaurant; current is gone; My head is paining; passed HSC; marks / result; coaching; discuss about / married with / return back; Myself Rafi; off day; bachelor / mess). Cards 30–42 are the bn-only pronunciation cards that §9 adds here instead of changing the shared pronunciation deck (zoo / Jew, vine / wine, ship / sheep, full / fool, see / she, heart / hurt, school; very, berry and hotel already exist in deck 18 and are not duplicated). Linked to the bn-only lesson banglish; no ko-en counterpart
